2607.09015.title: Correlation-Aware Contextual Bandits with Surrogate Rewards for LLM Routing
2607.09015.paper_summary: We study contextual bandit problems with correlated arms and access to surrogate reward signals produced by a machine learning model, motivated by applications such as large language model (LLM) routing. Unlike classical contextual bandits that rely solely on bandit feedback and assume conditional independence across arms, our setting allows context-dependent inter-arm correlations and auxiliary reward information that may be noisy or misspecified. We propose algorithms that leverage such surrogate rewards through two complementary designs. A coupled reward-mixing approach pools true and surrogate rewards to accelerate learning when surrogate signals are reliable, while a decoupled prediction-mixing approach maintains separate estimators for bandit feedback and surrogate rewards and adaptively combines their predictions. This decoupling yields robustness to surrogate misspecification, recovering regret guarantees comparable to reward-only bandit methods in the worst case, while achieving improved regret when surrogate predictions are sufficiently informative. We provide theoretical regret analyses for both approaches and evaluate them on LLM routing benchmarks under varying accuracy versus cost trade-offs. The results demonstrate improved sample efficiency and consistently better accuracy-cost trade-offs compared to standard contextual bandit baselines and strong static routing methods.
2607.09015.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究具有相關臂的上下文強盜問題，並接入由機器學習模型生成的替代獎勵信號，這一研究受到大型語言模型 (LLM) 路由等應用的啟發。與僅依賴強盜反饋並假設臂之間條件獨立的經典上下文強盜不同，我們的設定允許上下文依賴的臂間相關性和可能是噪聲或錯誤指定的輔助獎勵信息。我們提出了利用這些替代獎勵的算法，通過兩種互補的設計。耦合獎勵混合方法在替代信號可靠時，將真實獎勵和替代獎勵進行合併，以加速學習，而解耦預測混合方法則為強盜反饋和替代獎勵維持單獨的估計器，並自適應地結合它們的預測。這種解耦使得對替代錯誤指定具有穩健性，在最壞情況下恢復與僅基於獎勵的強盜方法相當的悔恨保證，同時在替代預測足夠信息豐富時實現改進的悔恨。我們為這兩種方法提供了理論悔恨分析，並在不同準確性與成本權衡下的LLM路由基準上進行評估。結果顯示，相較於標準上下文強盜基準和強大的靜態路由方法，我們的方法在樣本效率和準確性-成本權衡上均有顯著改善。
